title: VUA packages-ops result v0.4
description: Result documents for the packages-ops v0.4 write face slice A4 = repository add/remove (proposal 026 freeze batch 2026-09-19; the v0.1 A1 removal result row, the v0.2 A2 install/upgrade result row and the v0.3 A3 registration result row stay frozen and served untouched). Envelope mirrors the standing wire shape (schemaVersion/operation/result); the envelope const is the word-list-row family version 0.4 and the result document carries its own family const vua.packages-ops/v0.4 — the two versions are independent (the c914cf2 standing rule). Operation/kind lock extended to eight methods: BOTH preview methods are synchronous queries and answer kind=plan exactly (their failures are wire-envelope errors, not result arms); the apply methods, the A3 registration and ALL THREE A4 methods are nine-state tasks whose terminal reflux answers kind=receipt / kind=rejected / kind=registered / kind=repoReceipt respectively. kind=plan (changePlan): the A1/A2 shapes verbatim. kind=receipt: the A1 removeReceipt and A2 installReceipt shapes verbatim, key sets mutually exclusive. kind=registered: the A3 receipt verbatim. kind=repoReceipt: the A4 receipt — the MINIMAL honest audit shape, oneOf two mutually exclusive variants keyed by repoType: remote-added {repoType:'remote', url, name} and local-added {repoType:'local', path, name}; the ports answer Result<(), _> — NO actual-result payload exists, so each variant carries exactly the request echo beside schemaVersion/kind/repoType (the A3 registerReceipt minimal-shape law: additionalProperties:false forbids inventing more — no added timestamps, no row positions, no fetched-manifest contents). kind=removed {repoId echo} is the remove arm: the port answers unit, the removed row's id is the one fact the face has (already known from the request — the echo IS the audit link; no removed-row snapshot is invented: the row may carry absent-id facts this face never round-trips). kind=rejected: a typed guard refusal evaluated INSIDE the task; the guard closed set stands at the A1/A2 three values — A4 adds NO guard: add refusals are backend guard answers (repo_invalid / repo_fetch_failed / repo_write_failed), remove refusals are repo_not_found / repo_write_failed, and every one folds into execution_failed carrying the ORIGINAL port code inside detail as honest provenance (the A1/A2/A3 discipline; detail carries the verbatim vua.vpm.repo_* code plus the reason text); the rejected code pattern stays locked to ^vua\.packages\. — the reused vua.vpm.* codes never travel inside a rejected document. Capability absence never reaches a task: the wire gate answers the generic capability_missing as an envelope error before submit. additionalProperties:false everywhere is the false-assertion guard: facts with no port carrier (subscription timestamps, cache paths, row indices) are INVALID by schema, not merely discouraged.

packageId.description: The VPM package identifier (the manifest name). No tighter pattern is frozen: the word list transports facts, it does not re-litigate upstream id grammar.

version.description: Target version for installs; null for removals (port fact: Option, verbatim).

reason.description: Machine reason, e.g. transitive_dependency, conflict; null when the backend carries none (port fact: Option, verbatim).

items.description: Every change the request would make (ORC-WF-002: the plan must cover every change the backend will make). On the install face this includes transitive dependency installs and conflict-triggered remove rows.

conflicts.description: Free-text machine reasons for dependency breakage the change would cause — the transparency face; the confirm UI must warn, the authoritative verdict stays server-side.

destructive.description: True when the change set contains conflicts or legacy removals (ADR-0006) — the confirm UI must warn; a false assertion is checkable against the other four faces.

digest.description: FNV-1a over the canonical item list; the applyInstall confirmedDigest binds to exactly this value. NOTE (consumer narrowing): the v0.1/v0.2/v0.3/v0.4 plan shapes share the same key set — narrow by the schemaVersion literal, not by keys alone.

confirmedDigest.description: The digest the user confirmed, echoed — the audit link between the confirmation face and the executed result.

requestedPackageIds.description: The explicit request list, verbatim — the change list half of the audit receipt (the A1 removal variant; key set disjoint from installReceipt, registerReceipt and the A4 arms).

removedItems.description: What the backend actually removed (port apply_remove {removed: items} verbatim) — the actual-result half of the audit receipt.

confirmedDigest.description: The digest the user confirmed, echoed — the audit link between the confirmation face and the executed result.

version.description: The request's version-selection fact, verbatim: null = resolver-picked, a string = the pin.

requestedPackages.description: The explicit request rows, verbatim (version-selection semantics included) — the change list half of the audit receipt (the A2 install variant; key set disjoint from removeReceipt, registerReceipt and the A4 arms).

appliedItems.description: What the backend actually applied (port apply_install {applied: items} verbatim) — the actual-result half of the audit receipt. No minimum is invented: an honestly empty array transports as an empty array.

packageRoot.description: The request's packageRoot, echoed — the only fact the face has (the port answers Result<(), _>: no applied/removed payload exists, and the idempotent AlreadyAdded collapse means there is no first-vs-repeat fact either; additionalProperties:false forbids inventing one). Key set disjoint from removeReceipt, installReceipt and the A4 arms.

url.description: The request's url, echoed — the audit fact (the port answers Result<(), _>: no payload exists; additionalProperties:false forbids inventing more). Key set disjoint from localRepoAdded, repoRemoved and every prior receipt arm.

path.description: The request's path, echoed — the audit fact (the port answers Result<(), _>: no payload exists; additionalProperties:false forbids inventing more). Key set disjoint from remoteRepoAdded, repoRemoved and every prior receipt arm.

repoId.description: The removed row's repository id, echoed — the one fact the face has (the port answers Result<(), _>: the id is already the request's identifying fact, the echo IS the audit link; no removed-row snapshot is invented — a row may carry absent-id facts this face never round-trips). Key set disjoint from remoteRepoAdded, localRepoAdded and every prior receipt arm.

detail.description: Free-text provenance. On the A4 face every port refusal folds here with the ORIGINAL port code carried verbatim (vua.vpm.repo_invalid / vua.vpm.repo_not_found / vua.vpm.repo_fetch_failed / vua.vpm.repo_write_failed) plus the reason — the reused vua.vpm.* codes never travel in the code key (the 013 reuse-code law: the pattern above stays locked to the vua.packages. family).
